segments.dry: Several reviewers with dry skin describe the serum as their go-to for daily hydration and say it has become a staple for year-round dryness, though one longtime user of the brand found a reformulated batch left her face tight and dry once absorbed.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe sensitive skin, including some with rosacea, report no bad reactions and say the serum feels calming and hydrating rather than irritating.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention mature or aging skin, including one who notes her age (73), report plumper, firmer-feeling skin and reduced appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
segments.combination: One reviewer with a normal T-zone and dry cheeks found this batch left her skin tight and dry, suspecting it might suit oilier skin better.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly softened fine lines, added plumpness, and a firmer, bouncier feel, particularly around the eyes; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe strong, lasting hydration and relief from dryness, even in winter climates; one reviewer, however, says her face remains dry in the mornings and is unsure the product is helping, and another found a recent batch left her skin tight and dry rather than moisturized.
concerns.redness: One reviewer specifically reports lightening redness alongside smoother skin; no other redness-specific reports are present.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a previously irritated, struggling skin barrier reports it feeling reset, calmer, and healthier within days of use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports a noticeable decrease in dark spots after consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports breaking out less after adding this serum to her routine, and another states breakouts stopped entirely; no reviewer in this set describes new or worsened breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers highlight that the serum hydrates without leaving an oily or greasy residue, describing it as lightweight and non-greasy even for those wary of feeling oily.
